description: Fully client-sided Fabric mod that overlays indicators above Nether roof bedrock to reveal what’s directly below. Helpful when trying to find the best spot to break bedrock.

mods.name: Roofify
mods.description: Client-side Fabric mod that overlays indicators above Nether roof bedrock to reveal what’s directly below. Green checkmarks for non-bedrock and counters for bedrock stacks helping you quickly spot openings. Configurable and toggleable.
